title: exercise.json
description: An exercise's manifest: its title, its week, what each question is worth, and the dates it opens and closes. The questions themselves are `questions.html` and the worked answers are `key.html`, which is never a student's.

id.description: generated by `POST …/exercises`; the server overwrites it with the one in the path

title.description: the exercise's title, in the course's language

questions.description: the questions in the fragment's own order; `id` is derived from questions.html and `points` is the author's

grades.description: written when the lecturer releases the grades (plan 04); a client body carrying it is a 400

released.description: when the grades were released; null until they are

by.description: who created it; written by the create route

question.description: one question: the data-id of its section in questions.html, and what it is worth

id.description: the data-id of the top-level section in questions.html; derived on every save of the questions, never chosen

points.description: what this question is worth; null until the author prices it, which blocks releasing a grade and not saving

release.description: when the exercise opens to students, when it is due, and the late rule

from.description: ISO timestamp: before this a student does not see the questions

due.description: ISO timestamp: after this a submission is late

late.description: `accept` takes a late submission and flags it; `refuse` answers 409

week.description: the teaching week this belongs to, 1-52; null or absent means unscheduled
